prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1365; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover, trunk lid and both tail light assemblies show crushed plastic and cracked mounts, which is largely consistent with the reported rear-end impact. Light scuffing and a bent license plate bracket also match the direction of force described. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from our records or the owner's account. The repair labor hours listed fit the work needed to restore the affected panels and wiring. Two similar charges submitted on the same day are currently being verified against the parts and labor detail before approval. Repair plan: replace the bumper cover and tail lamps, straighten the bracket, refinish the trunk lid and blend the adjacent paint.
